name: Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale, abbreviated (NEWS-A questionnaire)
description: Faithful replication of the abbreviated Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale (NEWS-A), the most widely used questionnaire on how residents perceive the walkability of their own neighborhood. The NEWS was introduced by Saelens, Sallis, Black & Chen (2003, American Journal of Public Health 93(9), 1552–1558); the 54-item short form was derived by Cerin, Saelens, Sallis & Frank (2006, Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise 38(9), 1682–1691) and cross-validated on 912 adults in the Baltimore region (Cerin et al. 2009, IJBNPA 6:32). Participants answer about their own neighborhood: A. types of residences (6 items, none–all), B. walking time to 23 kinds of stores and facilities (1-5 min to 30+ min, don't know), C. access to services, D. streets, E. places for walking and cycling, F. surroundings/aesthetics, G. traffic hazards, H. crime, and four single items (parking, cul-de-sacs, hills, barriers), all on a 4-point strongly disagree–strongly agree scale. Item wording, section instructions and answer labels are taken word for word from the sample survey on the authors' website (drjimsallis.com). The page also stores the subscale scores computed with the authors' individual-level scoring rules (NEWS-A Scoring, 2007) and shows the participant a short profile at the end. No images are needed. Analysis: subscale scores per respondent, compared between neighborhoods or related to walking and physical activity. Differences from the original: (1) on screen, answers are tapped instead of circled on paper, and the progress note between sections is left out; (2) "not applicable" for "your job or school" is an answer option, left out of that respondent's land-use mix score; (3) age and gender questions and the closing profile are added by us. The questionnaire is offered by its authors for research use; the template is taken down if they object.
author: Cerin, Saelens, Sallis & Frank

elements.name: c2
elements.title: There are many places to go within easy walking distance of my home.

elements.name: c3
elements.title: It is easy to walk to a transit stop (bus, train) from my home.

elements.name: d1
elements.title: The distance between intersections in my neighborhood is usually short (100 yards or less; the length of a football field or less).
elements.description: Subscale D, Street connectivity: mean of the items; higher = higher walkability.

elements.name: d2
elements.title: There are many alternative routes for getting from place to place in my neighborhood. (I don't have to go the same way every time.)

elements.name: e1
elements.title: There are sidewalks on most of the streets in my neighborhood.
elements.description: Subscale E, Infrastructure and safety for walking: mean of the items; higher = higher walkability.

elements.name: e2
elements.title: Sidewalks are separated from the road/traffic in my neighborhood by parked cars.

elements.name: e3

elements.name: e4
elements.title: My neighborhood streets are well lit at night.

elements.name: e5
elements.title: Walkers and bikers on the streets in my neighborhood can be easily seen by people in their homes.

elements.name: e6

elements.name: f1
elements.title: There are trees along the streets in my neighborhood.
elements.description: Subscale F, Aesthetics: mean of the items; higher = higher walkability.

elements.name: f2
elements.title: There are many interesting things to look at while walking in my neighborhood.

elements.name: f3
elements.title: There are many attractive natural sights in my neighborhood (such as landscaping, views).

elements.name: f4
elements.title: There are attractive buildings/homes in my neighborhood.

elements.name: g1
elements.title: There is so much traffic along nearby streets that it makes it difficult or unpleasant to walk in my neighborhood.
elements.description: Subscale G, Traffic hazards: mean of the items with item G2 reverse coded (5 − value); higher = lower walkability.

elements.name: g2
elements.title: The speed of traffic on most nearby streets is usually slow (30 mph or less).

elements.name: g3
elements.title: Most drivers exceed the posted speed limits while driving in my neighborhood.

elements.name: h1
elements.title: There is a high crime rate in my neighborhood.
elements.description: Subscale H, Crime: mean of the items; higher = lower walkability.

elements.name: h2
elements.title: The crime rate in my neighborhood makes it unsafe to go on walks during the day.

elements.name: h3
elements.title: The crime rate in my neighborhood makes it unsafe to go on walks at night.

elements.name: parking
elements.title: Parking is difficult in local shopping areas.
elements.description: Single item, lack of parking (higher = higher walkability).

elements.name: culdesacs
elements.title: The streets in my neighborhood do not have many cul-de-sacs (dead-end streets).
elements.description: Single item, lack of cul-de-sacs (higher = higher walkability).

elements.name: hilly
elements.title: The streets in my neighborhood are hilly, making my neighborhood difficult to walk in.

elements.name: barriers
elements.title: There are major barriers to walking in my local area that make it hard to get from place to place (for example, freeways, railway lines, rivers).
elements.description: Single item, physical barriers (higher = lower walkability).

elements.name: age
elements.title: Your age

elements.name: gender
elements.title: Your gender

elements.name: news_scores

elements.description: Value: {residential_density, land_use_mix_diversity, land_use_mix_access, street_connectivity, infrastructure_and_safety_for_walking, aesthetics, traffic_hazards, crime, lack_of_parking, lack_of_cul_de_sacs, hilliness, physical_barriers}, computed with the authors' individual-level scoring (NEWS-A Scoring, updated 24 September 2007). <style>
:root{--bg:#f2f1ed;--card:#fff;--ink:#1d1e21;--muted:#5d6066;--accent:#2f6b52;--accent-ink:#fff;--line:#d9d6cf;--warn:#b3261e}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,sans-serif}
main{max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:20px 16px 40px}h1{font-size:1.3rem;margin:0 0 8px}p{margin:0 0 10px;color:var(--muted)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:16px;margin-top:14px}
.btn{appearance:none;border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:12px 20px;font:inherit;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}
.btn.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--accent);border:1px solid var(--accent)}.btn.sm{padding:7px 12px;font-size:.9rem}.btn.sel{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px;align-items:center}
.q{margin-top:16px}.q>b{display:block;margin-bottom:6px;font-weight:600}
textarea,input[type=text],input[type=number]{width:100%;font:inherit;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink)}
textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical}input[type=number]{width:140px}
label.o{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:8px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;margin-top:6px;cursor:pointer}
.step{display:inline-block;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:#dfeee8;color:#174a39;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.sheet{position:relative;border:1px solid #bdb9b0;background:#fffdf8;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}
.sheet canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;cursor:crosshair;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
.sheet input{position:absolute;width:150px;padding:3px 6px;font-size:.85rem;border:1px solid var(--accent);border-radius:6px;z-index:2}
.tools{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:8px 0}
.clock{margin-left:auto;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--muted);font-size:.9rem}
.compass{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,56px);gap:6px;margin-top:8px}
.compass button{height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;font-size:1.2rem;cursor:pointer}.compass button.sel{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.legend{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}.legend i{display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;margin-right:5px;vertical-align:-1px}
.err{color:var(--warn);margin-top:8px;min-height:1.2em}
.credit{max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px 24px;font-size:.78rem;color:var(--muted)}
.it{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.it .t{font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}.it.miss .t{color:var(--warn)}
.opts{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}.opts button{flex:1 1 0;min-width:88px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 6px;font:inherit;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
.opts button.sel{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;border-color:var(--accent)}
.bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(120px,1.3fr) 2fr 64px;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:8px;font-size:.92rem}.bar .tr{height:12px;background:#eceae4;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}.bar .tr i{display:block;height:100%}.bar .n{text-align:right;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
@media(max-width:700px){.opts button{min-width:30%}}
</style>

<body>
<main id="app" aria-live="polite"><p>Loading…</p></main>
<footer class="credit">Questionnaire: Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale – Abbreviated (NEWS-A). Saelens, B. E., Sallis, J. F., Black, J. B., & Chen, D. (2003). <i>American Journal of Public Health</i>, 93(9), 1552–1558; Cerin, E., Saelens, B. E., Sallis, J. F., & Frank, L. D. (2006). <i>Medicine & Science in Sports & Exercise</i>, 38(9), 1682–1691. Wording from the sample survey on the authors' website (drjimsallis.com).</footer>
<script>
(function(){
  var app=document.getElementById('app'),A={};
  function esc(s){return String(s==null?'':s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"'}[c];});}
  function err(m){var e=app.querySelector('.err');if(e)e.textContent=m||'';}
  function ok(r){return !(r&&r.ok===false);}
  function has(n){var v=A[n];return v!=null&&v!=='';}
  function Q(n){return SPSite.getQuestion(n);}
  function seq(p,n){var a=[];for(var i=1;i<=n;i++)a.push(p+i);return a;}
  var CIRCLE='Please choose the answer that best applies to you and your neighborhood.';
  var PAGES=[
    {step:'Part 1 of 5',groups:[{head:'A. Types of residences in your neighborhood',note:CIRCLE,names:seq('a',6)}]},
    {step:'Part 2 of 5',groups:[{head:'B. Stores, facilities, and other things in your neighborhood',note:'About how long would it take to get from your home to the nearest businesses or facilities listed below if you walked to them? Please choose only one answer for each business or facility.',names:seq('b',23)}]},
    {step:'Part 3 of 5',groups:[{head:'C. Access to services',note:CIRCLE+' Both local and within walking distance mean within a 10-15 minute walk from your home.',names:seq('c',3)},{head:'D. Streets in my neighborhood',note:CIRCLE,names:seq('d',2)}]},
    {step:'Part 4 of 5',groups:[{head:'E. Places for walking and cycling',note:CIRCLE,names:seq('e',6)},{head:'F. Neighborhood surroundings/aesthetics',note:CIRCLE,names:seq('f',4)}]},
    {step:'Part 5 of 5',groups:[{head:'G. Traffic hazards',note:CIRCLE,names:seq('g',3)},{head:'H. Crime',names:seq('h',3)},{head:'Other features of your neighborhood',names:['parking','culdesacs','hilly','barriers']}]},
    {step:'About you',form:true,names:['age','gender']}];
  function names(P){if(P.form)return P.names;var a=[];P.groups.forEach(function(g){a=a.concat(g.names);});return a;}
  function saveAll(items,b,then){b.disabled=true;
    (function step(i){if(i>=items.length)return then();
      SPSite.answer(items[i][0],items[i][1]).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){b.disabled=false;return err(r.error);}A[items[i][0]]=items[i][1];step(i+1);});})(0);}
  function next(){window.scrollTo(0,0);
    if(A.consent!==true)return intro();
    for(var i=0;i<PAGES.length;i++){var ns=names(PAGES[i]);for(var j=0;j<ns.length;j++)if(!has(ns[j]))return PAGES[i].form?form(PAGES[i]):items(PAGES[i]);}
    if(!has('news_scores'))return score();
    finish();}
  function intro(){
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Your neighborhood</h1><p>We would like to find out more information about the way that you perceive or think about your neighborhood. Please answer the following questions about your neighborhood and yourself. It takes about 10 minutes.</p><div class="card"><p>'+esc(Q('consent').title)+'</p><div class="row"><button class="btn" id="yes">I agree</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('yes').onclick=function(){saveAll([['consent',true]],this,next);};}
  function items(P){
    var V={},h='<div class="card"><span class="step">'+esc(P.step)+'</span>';
    P.groups.forEach(function(g){h+='<h1 style="margin-top:14px">'+esc(g.head)+'</h1>'+(g.note?'<p>'+esc(g.note)+'</p>':'');
      g.names.forEach(function(n){var q=Q(n);h+='<div class="it" data-n="'+n+'"><div class="t">'+esc(q.title)+'</div><div class="opts">'+q.choices.map(function(c){return '<button type="button" data-v="'+esc(c.value)+'">'+esc(c.text)+'</button>';}).join('')+'</div></div>';});});
    app.innerHTML=h+'<div class="row"><button class="btn" id="go">Continue</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    app.querySelectorAll('.it').forEach(function(it){var n=it.getAttribute('data-n');it.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){b.onclick=function(){var v=b.getAttribute('data-v');V[n]=/^\d+$/.test(v)?Number(v):v;it.classList.remove('miss');it.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('sel',x===b);});err('');};});});
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){var ns=names(P),miss=ns.filter(function(n){return V[n]==null;});
      if(miss.length){app.querySelectorAll('.it').forEach(function(it){it.classList.toggle('miss',V[it.getAttribute('data-n')]==null);});var f=app.querySelector('.it.miss');if(f)f.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return err('Please answer every line. '+miss.length+(miss.length>1?' are':' is')+' still open.');}
      saveAll(ns.map(function(n){return [n,V[n]];}),this,next);};}
  function form(P){
    var h='<div class="card"><span class="step">'+esc(P.step)+'</span>';
    P.names.forEach(function(n){var q=Q(n);h+='<div class="q"><b>'+esc(q.title)+'</b>';
      if(q.type==='radiogroup')h+=q.choices.map(function(c){return '<label class="o"><input type="radio" name="'+n+'" value="'+esc(c.value)+'"> '+esc(c.text)+'</label>';}).join('');
      else h+='<input id="f_'+n+'" type="'+(q.kind==='number'?'number':'text')+'"'+(q.kind==='number'?' min="10" max="110"':'')+'>';
      h+='</div>';});
    app.innerHTML=h+'<div class="row"><button class="btn" id="go">Finish</button></div><div class="err"></div></div>';
    document.getElementById('go').onclick=function(){var it=[];
      for(var k=0;k<P.names.length;k++){var n=P.names[k],q=Q(n),x;
        if(q.type==='radiogroup'){var c=app.querySelector('input[name="'+n+'"]:checked');x=c?c.value:'';}
        else{x=document.getElementById('f_'+n).value.trim();if(q.kind==='number'&&x!==''){x=Number(x);if(isNaN(x)||x<10||x>110)return err('Please enter your age in years.');}}
        if(x==='')return err('Please answer: '+q.title);
        it.push([n,x]);}
      saveAll(it,this,next);};}
  function mean(ns,f){var s=0;ns.forEach(function(n){s+=f?f(A[n],n):Number(A[n]);});return Math.round(s/ns.length*100)/100;}
  function compute(){
    var bn=seq('b',23).filter(function(n){return A[n]!=='na';});
    return {residential_density:Number(A.a1)+12*A.a2+10*A.a3+25*A.a4+50*A.a5+75*A.a6,
      land_use_mix_diversity:mean(bn,function(v){return 6-(v===8?5:Number(v));}),
      land_use_mix_access:mean(seq('c',3)),street_connectivity:mean(seq('d',2)),
      infrastructure_and_safety_for_walking:mean(seq('e',6)),aesthetics:mean(seq('f',4)),
      traffic_hazards:mean(seq('g',3),function(v,n){return n==='g2'?5-v:Number(v);}),crime:mean(seq('h',3)),
      lack_of_parking:Number(A.parking),lack_of_cul_de_sacs:Number(A.culdesacs),hilliness:Number(A.hilly),physical_barriers:Number(A.barriers)};}
  function score(){var s=compute();SPSite.answer('news_scores',s).then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){app.innerHTML='<p class="err">'+esc(r.error)+'</p>';return;}A.news_scores=s;finish();});}
  function finish(){
    var s=A.news_scores||compute(),R=[['Shops and services within walking distance',s.land_use_mix_diversity,5,1],['Easy access to services',s.land_use_mix_access,4,1],['Connected streets',s.street_connectivity,4,1],['Places for walking',s.infrastructure_and_safety_for_walking,4,1],['Attractive surroundings',s.aesthetics,4,1],['Traffic hazards',s.traffic_hazards,4,0],['Crime',s.crime,4,0]];
    app.innerHTML='<h1>Thank you!</h1><div class="card"><p>This is how you see your neighborhood on the scales of the Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale. For the first five lines a longer bar means a more walkable neighborhood; for the last two a longer bar means more of a problem.</p>'+R.map(function(r){return '<div class="bar"><span>'+esc(r[0])+'</span><span class="tr"><i style="width:'+Math.round((r[1]-1)/(r[2]-1)*100)+'%;background:'+(r[3]?'#2f7d5b':'#b3542e')+'"></i></span><span class="n">'+r[1].toFixed(1)+' / '+r[2]+'</span></div>';}).join('')+'<p style="margin-top:12px">Researchers use these answers to study how the places people live in are related to how much they walk and cycle.</p><p id="fin">Submitting…</p><div class="err"></div></div>';
    SPSite.complete().then(function(r){if(!ok(r)){err(r.error||'Some answers are missing.');return;}var e=document.getElementById('fin');if(e)e.textContent='Your answers have been saved. You can close this window now.';});}
  SPSite.onReady(function(ctx){A=(ctx&&ctx.answers)||{};next();});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

config.description: The 54-item abbreviated Neighborhood Environment Walkability Scale: how residents perceive the housing types, shops and services, streets, places for walking, surroundings, traffic and crime in their own neighborhood.
